description: Unit tests for HuffmanBuilder class, verifying Huffman encoding properties and tree serialization.

methods.name: NoPrefixCollision
methods.description: Test that Huffman representations do not prefix each other.

methods.name: NoMissingInputs
methods.description: Test that all used characters have representations and no extra are created.

methods.name: OptimalCodeOrder
methods.description: Verify that higher frequency characters have shorter or equal length codes.

methods.name: ToVector
methods.description: Test the serialization of Huffman tree into a byte vector.

methods.name: ToVectorSingle
methods.description: Test serialization when only one character is used, ensuring a minimal tree.
